redfin.remarks: Welcome to Greenwood Square, an intimate village-style enclave in the heart of Van Nuys. This sophisticated three-level, three bedroom-three bath, small-lot single-family residence, built in 2016, offers a rare blend of modern design, comfort, and refined living. Bathed in natural light, the open-concept main level showcases a seamless flow ideal for elevated everyday living and entertaining. The chef’s kitchen is appointed with granite countertops , abundant custom cabinetry , and energy-efficient appliances , opening to a generous dining area and an elegant living room enhanced by built-in shelving. A guest bedroom and bath complete the main level. The upper floor features a serene primary suite with dual closets, including a spacious walk-in, along with a well-appointed junior suite offering a private bath—perfect for guests or a private office. A dedicated laundry area adds convenience. Thoughtful upgrades include dual-pane windows, recessed lighting, an interior fire sprinkler system, tankless water heater, and a private attached two-car garage with direct access and EV charging capability. Residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds with paver-lined streets, lush landscaping, guest parking, and a private playground—all within a pet-friendly community with low HOA dues. Ideally located near premier shopping, dining, and commuter access. A refined, move-in ready residence offering style, comfort, and exceptional value. This home qualifies for a $10,000 Home Buyer Access Grant. It is FHA approved.
